name: person-avatar
title: Person Avatar
description: A person's avatar — the photo, else initials on their hue, else initials on the muted fallback — the one way every people surface draws a person.

meta.whenToUse: Any avatar that stands for a person: rows, chips, cards, menus, comments and the user menu.
meta.whenNotToUse: An organisation or record image (Thumbnail), a space (IconGlyph), or a non-person avatar composition (Avatar).
